response.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_aCL_IgM FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> '' AND `ANA Pattern` <> 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY (AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) IS NULL), AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The patient qualifies if any examination has a non-null, non-blank ANA Pattern other than 'S'; the average is then taken over ALL of that patient's examinations, as the request says 'across all of their examinations'.
'Recorded' means the ANA Pattern is neither NULL nor an empty/blank string.
Ties in the average are not broken by any specific rule.

alternatives.interpretation: Average aCL IgM computed only over the examinations whose ANA Pattern is recorded and not 'S', rather than over all of the patient's examinations.
alternatives.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_aCL_IgM FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.`ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(e.`ANA Pattern`) <> '' AND e.`ANA Pattern` <> 'S' GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY (AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) IS NULL), AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) DESC LIMIT 10
